changelog:
v1.25.1 - Implement three new enemies (consulente, modella, bambino_fastidioso): configure enemy statistics, animations, and weapons; integrate into waves; implement dynamic shoot heights in WeaponSystem; support arcing banknote physics/thin rendering; implement in_love and bribed status effects + HUD icons; spawn bambino in clusters; and script custom AI behaviors (spiral circling, zig-zagging, and stop-to-attack windups).
v1.25.0 - Powers are now found while leveling up (were all unlocked from the start). The power-equip slot popup correctly showed only `unlocked_powers`, but `_setup_powers` was force-filling that roster with every power on run start (a v1 placeholder). Now powers are a PER-RUN progression like weapons: the roster starts EMPTY each run (reset in `_setup_powers` alongside the starting weapon), and each not-yet-owned power is offered as a "NEW!" level-up card; picking it adds the power to the roster and auto-equips it into the first free slot (slot 1 is always usable). The popup shows "Empty (No powers unlocked)" until you find one. New flow covered by the rewritten test_powers TEST 5.
